quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: U.S. FDA Approves Update to the Label for WINREVAIR (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The FDA approved an update to the WINREVAIR (sotatercept-csrk) label to include the Phase 3 HYPERION trial in adults diagnosed with PAH within the previous 12 months (N=320): adding WINREVAIR to background therapy reduced the risk of clinical worsening events by 76% versus placebo (HR 0.24, p<0.0001), with a first event in 10.6% versus 36.9% of patients. The update also adds a contraindication for serious hypersensitivity. Merck notes the European Respiratory Society's new PAH guidelines give WINREVAIR a 'strong' recommendation for patients on background therapy not at low risk, the only add-on PAH therapy to receive one.
